text: Why does the medium popcorn cost almost as much as the large?
Suddenly, the large looks like a steel.
The medium isn't there to sell.
It's there to make the large look cheap.
An economist offer, web $59, print $125, print plus web also $125.
Dan Ariely said 84% of his students picked the combo, removed the useless print option
But here's the twist, that test used students, not real subscribers.
Two of Ariely's other papers have since been retracted over data problems, and bigger
studies found the decoy effect is often weak in real life. That's the mirage. Even the
trick about tricks can be an illusion. So don't fear the medium. Just ask, would I buy the
large without it? This is Money Mirage. Follow for more.
